prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, half-up half-down auburn hair — wearing a skin-tight micro ski set, a cropped sleeveless ski top of ultra-thin wet-look electric-orange PU knit with a high funnel collar, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the wet-look PU knit fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro flared ski skirt of the same wet-look PU knit with a white stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit up the left side from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the wet-look PU knit shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark beside her navel. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin wet-look PU knit molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the high funnel collar, the wet-look sheen and the white hem stripe crisp against the orange, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy electric orange leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in electric orange lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a sunlit castle courtyard with a worn cobblestone floor, a standard-height arched gate, low stone steps and a waist-high well edge, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
